rows.section: Tariff rules (Geneva)
rows.label: Married couples and single parents
rows.value: Married couples, and single parents living with dependent children or relatives: the rate that corresponds to 50% of the income (art. 41 al. 2 and 3 LIPP); 55.56% for a parent sharing custody equally (al. 4)

rows.section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Genève; other communes differ) and church tax
rows.label: Cantonal multiplier (multiple of the simple tax)
rows.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Genève; other communes in Geneva set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
rows.source_title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der natürlichen Personen (XLSX, sheet NP 2026; updated 14 September 2026)

rows.section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Genève; other communes differ) and church tax
rows.label: Cantonal multiplier: note
rows.value: 147.5% of the base tax, less a 12% rebate on that cantonal tax (ESTV note 9)
rows.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Genève; other communes in Geneva set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
